title: Coronagraph Watch
text:
🔭 Coronagraph Watch — September 24, 2026

NASA’s DONKI reported a new coronal mass ejection, so Sunny is taking a look at the outer corona.

☀️ CME start: September 24, 2026 at 02:53 UTC
💨 CME speed: 500 km/s
🏷 CME SCORE: C-type (500–999 km/s)
📐 CME half-angle: 10° (Narrow)
📍 Source: Active Region 14536 — N03W32 (western central disk)
🌎 WSA-ENLIL Earth outlook: No or little Earth impact modeled

Sunny has his eyes on the corona. 👀☀️

Image: NOAA SWPC — LASCO C3
Data: NASA DONKI + NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
